facing: -Y blender / +Z godot (courier.tscn turns the model to face -Z)

Walk_Back.note: time-reversed Walk: toe-first steps; the body moves backwards

Jump.note: air pose loop; same hips offset as Jump_Start

Strafe_L.note: side steps; the body moves to the character's left

Strafe_R.note: side steps; the body moves to the character's right

Land_Hard.note: Jump_Land with a deep knee bend

Bike_Pedal.note: one forward crank revolution; frame k <-> crank angle 360*k/30 deg from rest (right crank forward)

Bike_Seated.note: crank at rest (right pedal forward), breathing

Bag_Worn_Idle.note: Idle wearing the backpack: thumbs hooked under the shoulder straps (the library Idle's hands-behind pose would go through the bag)

Bag_TakeOff.note: right strap off, the bag slides down the left arm into the left hand, comes round to the front, flap drops open towards the courier

Bag_Hold.note: standing, the open bag held in front: left hand on the top handle, right palm on its side

Bag_PackItem.note: left hand holds the bag; the right hand brings the package (lying on the palm) in and pushes it into the top compartment

Bag_TakeItem.note: the right hand reaches into the top compartment, pulls the package out by its near edge and brings it out lying on the palm; the left hand holds the bag

Bag_PutOn.note: a flick of the left hand swings the flap up, the right palm presses it shut, the bag swings to the left side and up onto the back (left arm through the left strap), right arm into the right strap, settle

Bag_PutOn_Holding.note: the right hand keeps the package; a flick of the left hand shuts the flap, the bag swings round the left side onto the left shoulder only (right strap stays off), both hands take the package (ends in the Carry_Idle pose). Follow with Handover / PlaceDown, then Bag_StrapRight

Bag_StrapRight.note: bag on the left shoulder only: the right arm reaches back into the right strap and pulls it onto the shoulder (ends in the Bag_Worn_Idle pose)

Carry_Idle.note: standing, a package held in front with both hands (forearms level)

Carry_Walk.note: Walk with a package held in front with both hands; legs, feet and speed exactly as Walk

Handover.note: offer the package forward with both hands, the customer takes it at frame 19, hands come back

PlaceDown.note: squat and set the package on the ground in front (leave at door), release at frame 18, stand up

Walk_Bag.note: Walk with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)

Walk_Back_Bag.note: Walk_Back with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (time-reversed Walk: toe-first steps; the body moves backwards)

Jog_Bag.note: Jog with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)

Run_Bag.note: Run with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (library Jog_Fwd: a fast run)

Sprint_Bag.note: Sprint with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)

Strafe_L_Bag.note: Strafe_L with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (side steps; the body moves to the character's left)

Strafe_R_Bag.note: Strafe_R with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (side steps; the body moves to the character's right)

Turn_L_90_Bag.note: Turn_L_90 with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)

Turn_R_90_Bag.note: Turn_R_90 with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)

Jump_Start_Bag.note: Jump_Start with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)

Jump_Bag.note: Jump with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (air pose loop; same hips offset as Jump_Start)

Jump_Land_Bag.note: Jump_Land with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)

Land_Hard_Bag.note: Land_Hard with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (Jump_Land with a deep knee bend)

Interact_Bag.note: Interact with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)

PickUp_Bag.note: PickUp with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)
